messages:
maya: Heads up — infra-bot alerted 8 Xid spikes on eu-west-1 node gpu-089, 3 distinct PIDs. Auto-cordon suggested but region fallback not enabled. Soft-cordon? :thinking_face:

ajay: Can you paste the bot log? want timestamps + job ids.

infra-bot: ALERT: gpu-089 (eu-west-1) | ECC spikes=2 | XID spikes=8 | health_score=0.68 | suggested_action=soft_cordon | soft_ttl=600s | link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1794504321

sophia: If we soft-cordon, Slurm batch jobs may keep running until next checkpoint — might affect batch SLA. For k8s pods set evictionGrace=60s. We need per-cluster policy.

tom: Region capacity in eu-west-1 is low rn. Cordoning gpu-089 could force spill to eu-central and increase egress/cost. What's failure probability vs transient flake?

ajay: Suggest hysteresis: require >=3 XID spikes within 5m AND ECC_errors >1. Annotate node with flaky:gpu so ops can query.

maya: Proposed healthhook (canary):
```yaml
healthhook:
  name: gpu-ecc-xid
  window: 300s
  xid_threshold: 5
  ecc_threshold: 2
  soft_cordon: true
  soft_cordon_ttl: 600
  drain_after_failures: 3
  actions:
    - soft_cordon
    - notify: "#eng-infra"
    - escalate: on_drain
```

sophia: Add `region_capacity_check: true` + `fallback_policy: prefer_local_then_spill` to avoid cross-region by default.

tom: Also trigger autoscale (preemptible) before forcing drain if autoscale quota available — cheaper than cross-region.

maya: I'll push the canary to staging and run a synthetic XID spike test with the harness. ETA ~45m. I'll open a follow-up ticket with logs.

ajay: Add metric tags so any spillover shows cost_center=eu-west1-flaky-gpu. Helps chargebacks.

maya: 👍 will do. If canary shows repeatable spikes we'll escalate to replace GPU and schedule maintenance.
